introduction.title: Scope and service provider
introduction.content: Shenzhen Zhama Future Technology Co., Ltd. ("we") provides the Zhama website, the TeGo digital avatar workspace, and the public ZhaMa mobile app (also named 扎马AI). This policy explains how these services access, collect, use, store, disclose and delete personal information.
introduction.content2: The processor and processing location can vary with the server, digital avatar, model or extension you choose. Enterprise private deployments and third-party self-hosted servers are managed by their operators; please also review their privacy notices. We process data as needed to provide the features you use, secure the service or meet legal obligations.

collection.title: Information we process and why
collection.content: The data processed depends on the features you use. A device permission does not mean that we read or upload all content on the device:

items.title: Account and authentication:
items.content: Usernames, user IDs, display names, email addresses, phone numbers and login verification information support registration, sign-in, account management and security. Google or Apple sign-in processes the provider account identifier, the name and email you authorize the provider to supply (which may be an Apple private relay address), and sign-in verification information. Linking Apple associates that identity with your current account. Credentials needed to revoke Apple authorization upon account deletion are stored encrypted on your connected server. We do not receive your Google or Apple account password.

items.title: Chats and digital avatar content:
items.content: Messages, prompts, AI responses, conversation history, memories and knowledge-base content support answers, tasks you initiate, history and access across devices. Content is transmitted to the connected server and processed by the models or tools configured for the digital avatar.

items.title: Attachments and audio/video:
items.content: Photos, videos and files you select or capture, and voice or meeting audio you actively record, support attachment analysis, speech recognition, transcription and meeting summaries. Cloud processing requires uploading the relevant content. Failed or incomplete recordings may remain on your device so you can retry or remove them.

items.title: Device data authorized for a feature:
items.content: After you authorize the relevant feature, location, contacts and calendar events involved in a tool request are processed for that assistant feature. Results may be returned to the connected digital avatar server. The public app does not use background location permission or request broad access to your photo or video library.

items.title: Apple Health (HealthKit):
items.content: Off by default. Your avatar can read steps, heart rate, sleep and workout records at your request only after you enable avatar queries in Settings → System permissions and allow the corresponding read permissions in Apple Health. Results can include the relevant times and data sources, and workout distance and energy burned. Query results are returned to your connected server and may be processed by the AI model configured for that avatar to answer your personal health and fitness organization request. Results may be retained in chat and tool records under the deletion rules below. They are not used for medical diagnosis or treatment, advertising, marketing, profiling or data mining unrelated to this health feature. The app does not write to Apple Health. Review the connected server and model provider before enabling this feature.

items.title: Subscriptions and transactions:
items.content: Products purchased, subscription status, order or transaction identifiers and purchase receipts support purchase validation, entitlement restoration and billing support. Apple App Store or Google Play handles payment details; we do not collect full payment card details through in-app purchases.

items.title: Notifications and operational data:
items.content: Firebase installation IDs, FCM registration tokens or JPush registration IDs (depending on the distribution channel), device and operating-system details, app version, IP addresses and necessary request or error logs support delivery, device binding, troubleshooting and account or service security. Notifications may contain task or message summaries; manage lock-screen previews as needed.

items.title: Website inquiries and visits:
items.content: Contact details and messages submitted by form or email, together with necessary request information, support replies to inquiries. Depending on its deployment, the website may use cookies, local storage and web traffic statistics. Website statistics are managed separately from the public mobile app.

collection.usageIntro: Purposes and limits for the public mobile app:
usageItems: Data supports the account, chat, attachment, meeting, digital avatar tool, subscription and notification features you use, and their secure operation.
We do not use this data for advertising tracking, targeted marketing or additional user-behavior analytics. Firebase Analytics is not enabled in the public mobile app.
You may choose not to use recording, location, contacts, calendar, camera or attachment features and revoke device permissions in system settings. The corresponding features will be affected.
Do not upload recordings, contacts or other personal information about others without a lawful basis or necessary authorization.

permissions.title: Device permissions and controls
items: Microphone: Voice input and meetings you actively start recording. Android displays an ongoing notification during meeting recording. An active recording can continue when you switch apps; return to the meeting page to stop it. Recording does not start automatically at boot.
Camera and file selection: Scanning, capture and attachments you select. The Google Play public app uses system pickers for photos, videos or files and does not request broad media-library access.

Location, contacts and calendar: Used after authorization when needed for the relevant feature. The Google Play build excludes SMS/call-log reading, accessibility-driven cross-app automation and in-app APK installation updates. Official Android website/OSS downloads and private brands can offer photo-library access, SMS/call features and device automation after you actively authorize them; availability depends on the device and deployment.

Apple Health: Turn avatar queries off at any time in Settings → System permissions, and manage or revoke individual read permissions in Apple Health. Turning the feature off prevents further reads through it but does not automatically delete results already returned to the server or saved in chats. Delete the relevant chats or request deletion at contact@zhama.com.
Notifications: Messages, task updates and service status. Manage them in the app or system settings. Turning off notifications does not delete an account.

sharing.title: Service providers and disclosures
sharing.content: We do not sell or rent personal information. The following providers may receive the information needed to deliver the features you use:

items.title: Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM):
items.content: Official iOS and Google Play builds use FCM for notifications, involving installation IDs, registration tokens and delivery information. iOS also uses Apple Push Notification service (APNs). FCM does not mean that Google Analytics is enabled.

items.title: JPush (Aurora):
items.content: Official Android website/OSS downloads and private brands use JPush, provided by Shenzhen Hexun Huagu Information Technology Co., Ltd. For device registration, delivery and notification taps, the SDK processes device/app identifiers, JPush registration IDs, device model, operating system, app version, network/IP information and notification data. Push starts after sign-in and requests notification permission from the system. You can manage alerts through system notification permissions. We do not enable its advertising, marketing or additional user-behavior analytics features. Provider notice: https://www.jiguang.cn/license/privacy.

items.title: Sign-in and app stores:
items.content: Google or Apple provides authentication when its sign-in option is enabled. Apple linking and account deletion also require verification or revocation of the corresponding authorization. Apple App Store and Google Play provide distribution, purchases, subscriptions and payment verification. We process the corresponding authorization information, transaction identifiers and validation results.

items.title: AI, speech and tool providers:
items.content: Depending on the connected server and digital avatar configuration, chats, attachments or audio may be sent to the configured AI model, speech-recognition or tool provider. HealthKit query results that you actively enable and authorize may also be processed by the connected server and configured AI model, solely for the health and fitness query you initiate. For example, a configuration using Tencent Cloud speech recognition sends audio and necessary request information to Tencent Cloud. Providers vary by configuration; review the selected service and its policy before use.

items.title: Cloud infrastructure and storage:
items.content: Hosting, database and object-storage providers process accounts, content, attachments and necessary operational data under the relevant service arrangements for storage, transmission and maintenance.

items.title: Legal requirements:
items.content: We may disclose necessary information to meet regulatory, judicial or security obligations. We will provide required notice of a merger or business change involving a transfer of personal information.

security.title: Security and processing locations
security.content: We use access controls, authentication and necessary technical measures to protect personal information. Default public services use encrypted transport such as HTTPS. Transport for servers and extensions you connect yourself depends on their deployment; use trusted services with encrypted connections. Storage and processing locations depend on the connected server, cloud service and model provider and may involve international processing. Review these arrangements before selecting a service or uploading information. Separate notice or consent must be provided where applicable requirements call for it. No system can guarantee absolute security.

retention.title: Retention and deletion scope
retention.content: Accounts and personal cloud data such as conversations, attachments, memories and knowledge bases are retained as needed for the features and content you choose to keep. You may delete supported individual content or request account deletion to remove associated personal data and push bindings. Deactivation or sign-out is not account deletion.
retention.content2: Ownership of shared organizational resources or other users’ data must be checked, and administrative responsibility transferred where necessary, to avoid deleting others’ data. Transaction or installation records held independently by providers follow their retention rules; Firebase installation-ID removal, for example, follows its official data-processing notice. If a legal requirement requires particular data to be retained, we will explain the categories, purpose, basis and necessary period, limit its use accordingly, and delete or anonymize it when that period ends.

deletion.title: Delete your ZhaMa / TeGo account and data
deletion.intro: You can request account and associated personal-data deletion by email even after uninstalling the app. You do not need to reinstall it.
steps: Automatic in-app deletion: Sign in to the relevant server, open Settings → Delete account, and verify the account and confirm as prompted. When the deletion conditions are met, the server automatically deletes the account and associated personal data and signs you out.

Request by email: Write to contact@zhama.com with the subject “ZhaMa / TeGo account deletion”. Include your registered email or username, the connected server address, and a request to delete the account and associated data. Do not send passwords, verification codes or full payment details.

We will perform necessary identity checks and respond with progress and the outcome. If shared resources, organizational administration or other matters require attention, we will explain the reason and next steps. The same email provides support.

Deletion affects this account’s sign-in and data access in other clients on the same server. Export personal content you need first, and review or cancel unwanted auto-renewing subscriptions in Apple or Google subscription settings. Account deletion does not replace app-store subscription management.
deletion.data: Deletion covers associated personal information including profile, credentials and sessions, personal chats and attachments, memories and knowledge bases, personal workspaces and push bindings. Shared resources follow ownership rules; provider-held or legally retained data follows the section above.
deletion.timing: Successful in-app deletion signs you out of that account. For email requests, we will respond within 30 days with the verification status, processing details and expected completion time, including any further information needed or legally required retention.

rights.title: Other data rights
rights.content: Where applicable requirements allow, use the app’s controls or contact@zhama.com to request access, correction, export, deletion of specific personal information or withdrawal of authorization without deleting the whole account for every request. We will verify identity and handle the request based on the data involved and applicable requirements.
items: View and correct profile and account information.
Delete conversations, attachments or other content with available controls, or describe the data to be deleted to support.
Revoke device permissions and notification authorization in system settings.
Ask about processing, service providers or copies of personal information.

children.title: Children and teens
children.content: The public service is intended for users aged 13 and above, not children under 13. Teens should use it with guardian guidance where required. If you learn that a child under 13 has provided personal information to us, contact contact@zhama.com so we can address it.

changes.title: Policy updates
changes.content: We will update this policy and its date when features, providers or processing practices change. Material changes affecting personal rights will receive notice or separate consent where required.

items: Service provider: Shenzhen Zhama Future Technology Co., Ltd.
contact.response: We will respond within 30 days and explain processing after verifying identity. Do not email passwords or verification codes.

coreTech.title: Secure sandboxes and in-house orchestration for digital employees at scale

items.label: Core tech 01
items.title: Identity-bound secure sandbox
items.description: When one digital employee serves many users, TeGo identifies the real requester and scopes data and tool permissions for that piece of work.
points: Verifies the runtime instance and the requester separately
Checks the data-mount scope
Constrains processes, network and resources
Business actions follow the requester's grants
items.value: Share digital employees while keeping each user's authorization boundary

items.label: Core tech 02
items.title: In-house runtime orchestration
items.description: Coordinates environment reuse, idle reclamation and instance allocation around permission scopes, active tasks and persistent state.
points: Scoped reuse by user, employee and workspace
Quota-aware reclamation that skips active tasks
Stateful allocation that preserves data ownership
items.value: Higher runtime efficiency under security constraints, with continuity

items.label: Core tech 03
items.title: Trusted execution
items.description: Links the real requester, the digital employee, key operations and outputs, with evidence export and offline verification.
points: Links requester, employee, task steps and deliverables
Hash chains and signature anchors verify integrity
Evidence packages for export and offline checks
items.value: Supports security reviews, decision audits and accountability

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: About TeGo Cloud, your data, and moving to Enterprise.

items.question: Are Cloud and Enterprise different products?
items.answer: No. Both are part of the TeGo Digital Employee Execution & Governance Platform. Cloud is designed for self-serve use and fast validation; Enterprise adds private deployment, deep customization, governance, and FDE support.

items.question: How does TeGo Cloud protect my data?
items.answer: Each user gets a dedicated workspace and data boundary. Organizations with data residency, private networking, or stricter audit requirements should choose Enterprise.

items.question: Can I move from Cloud to Enterprise later?
items.answer: Yes. When your team, workflow complexity, or compliance requirements grow, we can assess a migration and enterprise delivery plan with you.
